issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and other workflows
issues.desc: HAs and TCs were receiving double tasks for Loan Simple leads across multiple workflows including pre-referral and post-referral. The issue was caused by a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot. HubSpot support was engaged and confirmed the fix.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or dismiss the duplicate tasks.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that previously fell out of contract and returned to Offer Accepted
issues.desc: When a deal was flipped from Offer Accepted back to an earlier stage and then back to Offer Accepted again, the TC workflow tasks did not re-trigger. This was caused by 'deal stage = Offer Accepted' not being listed as a re-enrollment criterion in the workflow. Madelaine Davis updated the re-enrollment criteria to fix this.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any deals that were flipped back to Offer Accepted and did not receive TC workflow tasks during the impact window.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked as Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs were receiving post-referral workflow check-in tasks even after deals had been marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The issue was identified in early March and a tweak was made to the workflow filters to suppress tasks for these deal stages. Both Closed Lost and Transferred statuses were affected.
issues.workaround: Manually dismiss any erroneous check-in tasks received for deals already marked as Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Automated email showing previous loan officer after LO change on a deal
issues.desc: After a loan officer change was made on a deal, automated emails sent to the agent continued to display the old LO's information rather than the updated LO. The correct LO was visible in Dash but not reflected in workflow-triggered emails. The issue was resolved by Luis and classified as a product-level fix.
issues.workaround: Manually send a corrected email to the agent with the updated loan officer information for any deals where the wrong LO was communicated during the impact window.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow not triggering tasks after referral accepted on March 18th
issues.desc: An HA reported receiving no workflow tasks after a referral was made and accepted on March 18th. The root cause was an error in how data was being pulled, which prevented the workflow from filtering correctly and enrolling the deal. The issue was flagged to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll affected deals into the post-referral workflow and complete any missed tasks for leads accepted around or after March 18th.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent in Offer Accepted stage before closing info is available, missing credit amount
issues.desc: An SMS notifying the buyer of their credit amount was being triggered in the Offer Accepted stage, before closing information had been submitted and the credit amount could be calculated, resulting in the SMS going out with no dollar amount. The SMS should only fire in the Sale Pending stage once the credit amount is known. It was confirmed to be a Dash-triggered communication rather than a HubSpot workflow, and was referred to the product team.
issues.workaround: Manually send a corrected SMS or message to any buyers who received the incomplete credit amount notification during the Offer Accepted stage within the impact window.
